Equipment & combat

Implemented weapon mechanics use the native combat system. Staged checks include normal inventory actions, charges and actual damage.

Real mechanics, staged verification
01 / Melee

Fang & Voidwaker

Fang’s accuracy rules and special attack. Voidwaker’s magic-damage special, using the existing combat and special-energy system.

02 / Powered magic

Tumeken’s shadow

Powered attacks and equipment magic multipliers. Charge with soul and chaos runes, check remaining charges, and uncharge for a rune refund.

03 / Crystal equipment

Bowfa & crystal armour

Shard charging, shot-by-shot charge use and the corrupted bow variant. Canonical crystal armour adds accuracy and damage bonuses, with its own charges.

04 / Soul stacks

Soulreaper axe

Soul stacks, Strength scaling, timed stack decay and the Behead special attack, including the supported ornamented axe.

05 / Burn damage

Burning claws & Scorching bow

Weapon specials and timed burn damage. Scorching bow also applies its demon-target bonuses and special effects.

06 / Armour & spells

Inquisitor, Virtus & Ancient sceptre

Inquisitor’s crush bonuses, Virtus’s Ancient magic bonus and the Ancient sceptre’s additional spell effects.

More equipment to wear: Torva, Masori, Oathplate, Hueycoatl hide and newer accessories have imported appearance and base stats. Only the specifically implemented effects are promised.

Beyond the familiar map

More places to explore

The New lands menu opens travel to Civitas illa Fortis and other imported destinations. New areas include scenery, populated NPC locations, ordinary combat definitions, shop stock and loot where compatible handlers exist.

Still feels like Kronos

The existing home, account saves and familiar interface remain the foundation. Windows and Android retain their established layout and controls.

An updated client is required for the expanded cache. The older client is kept separate from this staged release.

Native encounters

Three implemented encounters have passed staged checks. Private encounters include exit handling and safe return on death.

What remains unfinished

This is an expanded playable foundation, not a claim that every OSRS242 activity has been ported.

Raids & progression

A complete Tombs of Amascut or Gauntlet progression and reward loop is not included. ToA-specific weapon logic does not make the raid playable.

Quests & Sailing

Imported maps and assets do not supply quest scripts, Sailing gameplay or every boss encounter.

Recipes & gear acquisition

Crystal singing and corruption, Soulreaper assembly, Voidwaker assembly and several reward routes remain missing. Some gear currently needs staff provision.

Economy & variant effects

Shops use base prices and native restocking; selling back is disabled. Unlisted weapon effects, cosmetic variants and conditional loot rules are not assumed complete.

What the current evidence means

Actual client captures show the interface, equipment, loaded areas and boss combat. Current checks cover seven weapons, normal charge actions, ten mouse-driven equip cases and native encounter behavior. These controlled checks are separate from a full playthrough, economy review or long-term balance test.
